  tail: **Change:** `save_report()` now writes to a temporary file first (via `tempfile.mkstemp` in the same directory), then atomically renames it to the target path u | This makes the write crash-safe because: | - On POSIX and Windows, `os.replace()` is atomic when source and destination are on the same filesystem | - If the process dies mid-write, the original `report.txt` remains untouched (or doesn't exist yet for the first run) | - The next job will never read a truncated or corrupted file
